BAJECard class compile: 'insufficientBalanceErrorDescription

	^''The card does not have enough balance to pay the trip''' classified: 'error descriptions'.
BAJECard class compile: 'transferTimeLimit

	^2 * hour' classified: 'transfers'.
BAJECard class compile: 'transferPriceFactor

	^1/2' classified: 'transfers'.
BAJECard class compile: 'noTransferPriceFactor

	^1' classified: 'transfers'.
BAJECard compile: 'pay: aFare forTripBoardingAt: aBoardingStop at: aDateTime

	| trip |
	trip := BAJETrip boardingAt: aBoardingStop at: aDateTime withFare: aFare priceFactor: (self priceFactorForTripAt: aDateTime).
	self assertCanPay: trip charge.

	balance := balance - trip charge.
	trips add: trip' classified: 'paying'.
BAJECard compile: 'assertCanPay: anAmount

	anAmount > balance ifTrue: [ self error: self class insufficientBalanceErrorDescription ]' classified: 'paying - private'.
BAJECard compile: 'priceFactorForTripAt: aDateTime

	"Discounts are not cumulative, so the best one is applied - Hernan"
	^(discount priceFactorForTripAt: aDateTime of: self) min: (self transferPriceFactorAt: aDateTime)' classified: 'paying - private'.
BAJECard compile: 'transferPriceFactorAt: aDateTime

	^(self isTransferAt: aDateTime)
		ifTrue: [ self class transferPriceFactor ]
		ifFalse: [ self class noTransferPriceFactor ]' classified: 'transfers'.
BAJECard compile: 'isTransferAt: aDateTime

	^trips notEmpty and: [ (trips last startTime distanceTo: aDateTime) <= self class transferTimeLimit ]' classified: 'transfers'.
BAJECard compile: 'numberOfTripsOn: aDate

	^trips count: [ :trip | trip startedOn: aDate ]' classified: 'trips'.

BAJETrip compile: 'startTime

	^startTime' classified: 'accessing'.
BAJETrip compile: 'startedOn: aDate

	^startTime date = aDate' classified: 'testing'.

StudentDiscount compile: 'priceFactorForTripAt: aDateTime of: aCard

	^(self isWeekend: aDateTime)
		ifTrue: [ 1 ]
		ifFalse: [ 1/2 ]' classified: 'price factor'.
StudentDiscount compile: 'isWeekend: aDateTime

	| day |
	day := aDateTime date day.

	^day isSaturday or: [ day isSunday ]' classified: 'price factor - private'.
RetireeDiscount compile: 'priceFactorForTripAt: aDateTime of: aCard

	^(aCard numberOfTripsOn: aDateTime date) < self numberOfFreeTripsPerDay
		ifTrue: [ 0 ]
		ifFalse: [ 1 ]' classified: 'price factor'.
RetireeDiscount compile: 'numberOfFreeTripsPerDay

	^2' classified: 'price factor - private'.
'ok'

BAJECard compile: 'priceFactorForTripAt: aDateTime

	"Discounts are not cumulative, so only the best one is applied"
	^(discount priceFactorForTripAt: aDateTime of: self) min: (self transferPriceFactorAt: aDateTime)' classified: 'paying - private'.
